lines.text: Ghost Town Radio. Hollis Vane, with you at midnight.
That is all the archive gives me on that. I will not guess.
This is Hollis Vane, one o'clock in the morning, on Ghost Town Radio. Let us see what the papers said about trouble.

Now a page from the archive. From Manual of Coorg a gazetter of the natural features of the country, and the social and political condition of its inhabitants, published in eighteen seventy. A man from the north of Coorg reported that Vfrardja shot at Ndrdyana Ndyaka with a blunt arrow and then a sharp arrow that killed him. The words themselves.

A man from the north of Coorg deposed: that he saw Vfrardja, on a hunting excursion, shooting atNdrdyana Ndyaka, Hobliddra, first with blunt arrows, then with a sharp arrow which killed him, in presence of all his retinue.

Fraserpet has a Roman Catholic Church, a newly built shrine dedicated to Ganapati with a public well, an Anglo-Vernacular School, a native rest-house with a tank, and a Government wood-yard. The town can boast of a Roman Catholic Church, a newly built shrine, dedicated to Ganapati, with a very useful public well in front of it, an Anglo- Vernacular School, a native rest- house with a tank and a Government wood-yard, besides the European bungalows.
